en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard with an Art Nouveau illustration of three women in flowing classical-style dresses picking and hanging flowers in front of a backdrop filled with blossoms. At the upper right are two smaller panels, one showing a close-up of a woman in profile among flowers and another decorative floral vignette. Much of the remaining space is filled with handwritten cursive text in Greek. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears along the bottom.
